name: earelin-plugins
description: Custom Claude Code plugins by earelin

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture plugin: an architecture-review skill plus create-adr and adr-review skills for authoring and reviewing Architecture Decision Records

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend plugin: a code-reviewer agent and a refactoring agent for reviewing and refactoring backend changes on the current branch or a pull request, plus a java-unit-test skill for writing Java unit tests

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: DevOps plugin: a code-reviewer agent and a refactoring agent for reviewing and refactoring CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure-as-code changes on the current branch or a pull request

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend plugin: a code-reviewer agent and a refactoring agent for reviewing and refactoring frontend changes on the current branch or a pull request

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub plugin: skills for creating and reading pull requests and issues with the gh CLI

plugins.name: specs
plugins.description: Specifications plugin: skills to author and review specs, features, and tasks in a traceable SPEC → feature → task flow
